scope: Cross-source follow-up: ibuprofen IR sample provenance and paracetamol UV-Vis research dataset

primary_source.title: SpectraBase — Ibuprofen ATR-IR Spectrum FFnOBP2bgVh
primary_source.publisher: John Wiley & Sons / Sigma-Aldrich sample record

findings.limitation: The page identifies a reference sample and spectrum but the numerical trace is not freely retrieved/validated in this workflow; database copyright/access terms apply.
findings.integration_decision: External reference only; do not digitize screenshot or claim local numerical integration.

findings.identity_caveat: This record is explicitly the S enantiomer and must not be represented as a racemic API measurement.
findings.rights_note: AIST states commercial/profit-making reuse requires prior permission and requests acknowledgement.
findings.integration_decision: Keep as external source reference; do not merge with racemic ibuprofen measurements.

primary_source.title: The impact of paracetamol impurities on face properties: investigating the surface of single crystals using TOF-SIMS — dataset
primary_source.contents: Dataset description includes UV-Vis spectrometry alongside AFM, TOF-SIMS, Raman microscopy, microscopy and other measurements.

findings.limitation: The listed archive is approximately 6.48 GB and contains mixed experiments; UV-Vis files must be isolated and sample/conditions verified before importing.
findings.integration_decision: Register as a research-data source only; no absorbance points imported.

primary_source.title: RSC supplementary information: Physical Chemistry Chemical Physics, c9cp04056k

findings.limitation: The reported values are literature peak descriptions, not a full numerical spectrum file.
findings.integration_decision: Do not use the listed approximate bands to synthesize a continuous curve.

scientific_note: This release adds source-audit records only. It does not add new experimental spectrum points or full curves.
